content.short: Verlux is a Community Driven Decentralized Cross-Chain NFT Marketplace.
content.description: Verlux is the first project on the Cardano Ecosystem that will be creating a Cross-Chain Swap Protocol with the use of Smart Contracts to allow users swap their NFTs from other blockchains to the Cardano blockchain while utilizing the low gas fees, speed and security of its network.
